raw_segments.text: Rakuten knows. Rakuten knows a lot, damn him. He's not going to be a monk. He means to go to Petersburg.
There he'll go in for criticism of an elevating tendency. Who knows, he may be of use and make his own career too.
Ah, they are first rate these people at making a career. Damn ethics, I am done for Alexei, I am you man of God.
I love you more than anyone. It makes my heart yearn to look at you. Who was Karl Bernard?
